intro: 我为国家科技创新 2030“脑科学与类脑研究”重大项目子课题开发强化学习数据采集与仿真回放工具链，让训练记录可以追溯到策略版本与可视化结果，支持实验问题定位和结果复查。

I developed an RL data-collection and simulation-replay toolchain for a subproject of the national Science and Technology Innovation 2030 “Brain Science and Brain-Like Research” program, linking training records to policy versions and visual results for experiment diagnosis and review.
bullets: 适配 Planax 轨迹与 SMAC 数据，连接导入校验、明细查询、曲线展示、checkpoint 归档和注释管理。
Adapted Planax trajectories and SMAC data for import validation, detailed queries, curve visualization, checkpoint archiving, and annotation management.
将归一化观测还原为有物理单位的飞行状态；下方图表直接取自一段真实五智能体训练日志，并随包提供对应数据。
Recovered physical flight quantities from normalized observations. The plot below uses an actual five-agent training log, with the corresponding data included.
联动策略恢复与 Tacview，管理 ACMI / SC2Replay 文件；形成从训练数据、实验与模型记录到仿真回放的可追溯链路。
Connected policy restoration with Tacview and managed ACMI / SC2Replay files, creating a traceable chain from training data and experiment/model records to simulation replay.
